title: PCSO lotto results Nov. 14: ₱365.51M jackpot not won

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱365.51 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱19.6 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026. The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 30-28-41-44-04-31, with a jackpot prize of ₱365.51 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers.
